mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 58 degrees that feels like 52 degrees, under a waning crescent moon phase.

In city updates, Fitch-Rona EMS welcomed Deputy Chief Liz Gay to lead administration and employee development. Additionally, pavement repair work is scheduled to begin Monday, November 9th, covering North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard.

Looking at local events, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow brings trivia night at The Bogey Factory and ART House 360 Thursday nights.
In this week's police recap, on Sunday, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for a vehicle stopped for twenty minutes, arresting the driver for O W I.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM featuring Dark Chocolate PB Crunch as today's flavor of the day.
